name: Escaping Ban'ethil
label: Quest
description: Escaping Ban'ethil: the quest giver's words, read aloud by the Lore Forever narrators.

clips.title: Quest text
paras: My prayers have been answered! I am thankful that you have fought your way down here.

I was sent here by the Oracle Tree to deliver a message to the slumbering druids here only to find it completely overrun by furbolg! They ambushed me before I could turn back and brought me down here--I fear for their next meal.
I don't know about you, but I loathe this place. Under the earth is no place for the kaldorei.

clips.title: Completion
paras: Thank Elune you were around to help Lynessa avoid a dark fate with the Gnarlpine. She's one of our best, and a personal friend.
Please, take this in thanks. May it serve you well in keeping the kaldorei safe.

sources.title: Quest text one player sent in, not confirmed by a second yet
